reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the upstream need records and performs exact need-to-capability matching. The resulting coverage marks only records with matching capabilities as direct and leaves n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported, matching the supplied inputs and declared role.

prioritize_needs contains the behaviorally significant fault: it sets unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. That inverts the intended meaning, ranks covered needs ahead of actually unsupported needs, and produces priorities where n06-r02 through n06-r08 covered records are treated as unsupported while n06-r01 and n06-r07 are treated as supported/low priority. This contradicts the declared role to rank unsupported needs before covered needs.

synthesize_recommendation correctly retains the eight-item priority window and constructs the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record. The wrong top_need is inherited from the faulty priorities table produced upstream, not introduced in this boundary.
